description: Which dates each NASA FIRMS satellite product actually covers — the first and last date available per sensor, for near-real-time and standard-processing streams. Call this before querying a historical date so an empty hotspot result can be read as "outside the archive" rather than "no fires".

source.description: A single product id (see firms_hotspots_area) or "ALL" for every sensor (default).

name: firms_data_availability
title: Firms Data Availability
